title: Next.js Integration
description: Set up Apollo Client with Next.js including App Router and Pages Router configurations.

data.text: Next.js App Router (introduced in Next.js 13) uses React Server Components by default. Apollo Client must be initialized on the client side. Use the `use client` directive and create a client singleton to avoid multiple instances.

data.title: Apollo Client setup for App Router
data.content: Create a client singleton and wrap your app with ApolloProvider.
